title: DSS 应变传感原理图册

routes.name: 自发布里渊 BOTDR
routes.observable: 自发布里渊回波频谱中心
routes.obs_en: Center of the spontaneous Brillouin spectrum
routes.summary: 单端发射脉冲；回波与同源频移本振相干检测，逐位置恢复 BFS。
routes.sum_en: Launch from one end and coherently detect the return with a frequency-shifted same-source local oscillator to recover BFS by position.

steps.label: B0 → Bp / BL · 分支 / Branches
steps.zh: 一支生成脉冲，一支保留为本振；不需要从远端注入连续探测光。
steps.en: One arm is pulsed and the other retained as a local oscillator; no continuous probe is injected at the far end.

steps.label: BBS + BL → i · 相干接收 / Coherent reception
steps.zh: Stokes 回波约为 ν0-νB；本振经单边带频移与滤波，把 GHz 量级布里渊光频差转到接收器带宽内。频移量与增减方向需标定。
steps.en: The Stokes return is near ν0-νB. Shift/filter the LO sideband to place the GHz-scale Brillouin beat inside the receiver bandwidth; calibrate the offset and its sign.

steps.label: 时窗 → z · 定位 / Localization
steps.zh: 按往返时延分窗，估计每窗频谱。脉宽与声子寿命会影响空间响应和谱宽。
steps.en: Window by round-trip delay and estimate each spectrum. Pulse duration and phonon lifetime affect spatial response and linewidth.

steps.label: ΔνB · 温度与应变 / Cross-sensitivity
steps.zh: 相对于参考状态的小变化模型。Cε 的单位为 Hz/单位应变（或 MHz/με），CT 为 Hz/K；不能混用单位或把单一频移当作两个未知量。
steps.en: A small-change model relative to a reference. Cε is in Hz per unit strain (or MHz/με), CT in Hz/K. One shift cannot identify two unknowns.

steps.label: 解耦 / Compensation
steps.zh: 应变测量需要独立温度信息；测温需要已知或隔离的光纤应变。光缆热膨胀与约束会改变有效标定。
steps.en: Strain sensing requires independent temperature information; thermometry requires known or isolated fiber strain. Cable expansion and constraint alter the effective calibration.

routes.limits: 自发散射信号弱，通常需要平均与扫频/谱估计；单端可达不意味着温度与应变自动分离。
routes.limits_en: Spontaneous returns are weak and usually require averaging and spectral estimation; single-ended access does not automatically separate strain and temperature.

routes.name: 受激布里渊 BOTDA
routes.summary: 泵浦脉冲与连续探测光反向传播，在逐位置增益谱中估计应变。
routes.sum_en: A pump pulse and CW probe counter-propagate; local gain spectra are converted to strain after compensation.

steps.label: B0 → Bp / Bs · 光源 / Source
steps.equation: Bp(t)=sqrt(Pp) a(t) exp(i 2πνp t);  Bs(t)=sqrt(Ps) exp(i 2πνs t)
steps.zh: 同源泵浦与探测支路分开。探测光经单边带调制及选边带滤波，下移到 νs=νp-Δν；两束在光纤中反向传播。
steps.en: Pump and probe are derived from the same source. Single-sideband modulation and sideband selection create νs=νp-Δν; the waves counter-propagate.

steps.label: G(z,Δν) · 增益谱 / Gain spectrum
steps.zh: 弱增益、近稳态条件下用洛伦兹线型拟合局部谱。强泵浦耗尽、脉冲瞬态及谱重叠会破坏简化模型。
steps.en: Fit a local Lorentzian in the weak-gain, near-steady regime. Pump depletion, pulse transients, and overlapping spectra can invalidate this approximation.

steps.label: i(t,Δν) → νB(z) · 定位 / Localization
steps.zh: 按触发时延定位，并扫描泵浦与探测频差 Δν；每个 z 拟合 Brillouin frequency shift，简称 BFS。
steps.en: Locate by trigger delay and scan the pump-probe detuning Δν. Fit the Brillouin frequency shift (BFS) at each position.

steps.label: ΔνB · 温度与应变 / Cross-sensitivity
steps.zh: 相对于参考状态的小变化模型。Cε 的单位为 Hz/单位应变（或 MHz/με），CT 为 Hz/K；不能混用单位或把单一频移当作两个未知量。
steps.en: A small-change model relative to a reference. Cε is in Hz per unit strain (or MHz/με), CT in Hz/K. One shift cannot identify two unknowns.

steps.label: 解耦 / Compensation
steps.zh: 应变测量需要独立温度信息；测温需要已知或隔离的光纤应变。光缆热膨胀与约束会改变有效标定。
steps.en: Strain sensing requires independent temperature information; thermometry requires known or isolated fiber strain. Cable expansion and constraint alter the effective calibration.

routes.limits: 通常需光纤两端可达或形成回路；泵浦耗尽、非局部效应、偏振与温度交叉敏感均须控制。
routes.limits_en: Normally needs access to both ends or a loop. Control depletion, non-local effects, polarization, and temperature cross-sensitivity.

routes.name: 差分脉宽对 DPP-BOTDA
routes.summary: 用共同起点、不同宽度的两组脉冲测量，差分提取短尾段的局部贡献。
routes.sum_en: Acquire two pulses with a common leading edge and different widths; their difference isolates the contribution of the short trailing interval.

steps.label: B0 → Bp / Bs · 光源 / Source
steps.equation: Bp(t)=sqrt(Pp) a(t) exp(i 2πνp t);  Bs(t)=sqrt(Ps) exp(i 2πνs t)
steps.zh: 同源泵浦与探测支路分开。探测光经单边带调制及选边带滤波，下移到 νs=νp-Δν；两束在光纤中反向传播。
steps.en: Pump and probe are derived from the same source. Single-sideband modulation and sideband selection create νs=νp-Δν; the waves counter-propagate.

steps.label: G1 / G2 → Gdiff · 差分 / Difference
steps.zh: 两组迹线先做时间对齐和功率归一；相同前沿条件下差值提取长脉冲尾段。
steps.en: Align timing and normalize power first; under matched leading-edge conditions, subtraction isolates the longer pulse tail.

steps.label: 尾段尺度 / Tail-interval scale
steps.zh: 这是理想差分门宽尺度；实际受脉冲边沿、接收带宽、声学瞬态与减法噪声限制。
steps.en: This is the ideal differential gate scale, limited in practice by pulse edges, receive bandwidth, acoustic transients, and subtraction noise.

steps.label: ΔνB · 温度与应变 / Cross-sensitivity
steps.zh: 相对于参考状态的小变化模型。Cε 的单位为 Hz/单位应变（或 MHz/με），CT 为 Hz/K；不能混用单位或把单一频移当作两个未知量。
steps.en: A small-change model relative to a reference. Cε is in Hz per unit strain (or MHz/με), CT in Hz/K. One shift cannot identify two unknowns.

steps.label: 解耦 / Compensation
steps.zh: 应变测量需要独立温度信息；测温需要已知或隔离的光纤应变。光缆热膨胀与约束会改变有效标定。
steps.en: Strain sensing requires independent temperature information; thermometry requires known or isolated fiber strain. Cable expansion and constraint alter the effective calibration.

routes.limits: 不能把小脉宽差当作无条件空间分辨率；两次采集中的状态变化会产生差分伪影。
routes.limits_en: A small width difference does not guarantee resolution; changes between acquisitions can create subtraction artifacts.

routes.name: 布里渊频域 BOFDA
routes.observable: 小信号复传递函数 H(fm,Δν)
routes.summary: 连续泵浦以小幅正弦强度调制；测量探测光响应的幅度与相位，再转为空间响应。
routes.sum_en: Apply small sinusoidal intensity modulation to a CW pump; measure probe amplitude and phase, then reconstruct space.

steps.label: Bp · 小信号调制 / Small-signal modulation
steps.zh: 扫描电学调制频率 fm，同时扫描光学泵浦-探测频差 Δν；两种频率不能混淆。
steps.en: Scan the electrical modulation fm and the optical pump-probe detuning Δν; these are different frequency axes.

steps.label: H · 复响应 / Complex response
steps.zh: VNA 或同步锁相测量相对发射调制的幅度与相位，不能仅测平均光强。
steps.en: A VNA or synchronous lock-in measures amplitude and phase relative to the pump modulation; mean intensity alone is insufficient.

steps.label: H → h(z) · 空间反演 / Spatial reconstruction
steps.zh: 延迟零点取决于系统参考；Δz≈c/(2ng Bm)，无歧义距离≈c/(2ng δfm)，均为理想尺度。
steps.en: Calibrate the delay origin. Δz≈c/(2ng Bm) and unambiguous range≈c/(2ng δfm) are ideal scales.

steps.label: ΔνB · 温度与应变 / Cross-sensitivity
steps.zh: 相对于参考状态的小变化模型。Cε 的单位为 Hz/单位应变（或 MHz/με），CT 为 Hz/K；不能混用单位或把单一频移当作两个未知量。
steps.en: A small-change model relative to a reference. Cε is in Hz per unit strain (or MHz/με), CT in Hz/K. One shift cannot identify two unknowns.

steps.label: 解耦 / Compensation
steps.zh: 应变测量需要独立温度信息；测温需要已知或隔离的光纤应变。光缆热膨胀与约束会改变有效标定。
steps.en: Strain sensing requires independent temperature information; thermometry requires known or isolated fiber strain. Cable expansion and constraint alter the effective calibration.

routes.limits: 傅里叶反演需有限带宽窗函数、参考去嵌入及声学响应考虑；不是把 BOTDA 的时间轴简单换个名字。
routes.limits_en: Reconstruction needs bandwidth/window treatment, reference de-embedding, and acoustic-response considerations; it is not merely a renamed BOTDA time axis.

routes.name: 布里渊相关域 BOCDA
routes.observable: 相关峰附近的局部增益谱
routes.obs_en: Local gain spectrum near a correlation peak
routes.summary: 共同频率调制的泵浦与探测光在特定位置形成频差匹配区；移动相关峰扫描光纤。
routes.sum_en: Common frequency modulation creates a localized pump-probe match; move the correlation peak to scan the fiber.

steps.label: B0 → Bp / Bs · 共同调制 / Common modulation
steps.zh: 对同源泵浦与探测施加相关频率调制，支路延迟决定相关峰位置。
steps.en: Apply correlated FM to same-source pump/probe waves; the arm delay sets the correlation-peak position.

steps.label: 局部相关 / Local correlation
steps.zh: 当两路调制在某位置对齐，局部频差较稳定；其他位置谱展宽形成背景。
steps.en: Where modulation delays match, local detuning is stable; mismatched positions give broadened background.

steps.label: 峰距 / Peak spacing
steps.zh: 这是正弦 FM 实现的峰距及分辨率趋势；比例系数取决于线宽、调制与门控，须依据实际实现计算。
steps.en: For sinusoidal FM this gives peak spacing and a resolution trend; prefactors depend on linewidth, modulation, and gating.

steps.label: ΔνB · 温度与应变 / Cross-sensitivity
steps.zh: 相对于参考状态的小变化模型。Cε 的单位为 Hz/单位应变（或 MHz/με），CT 为 Hz/K；不能混用单位或把单一频移当作两个未知量。
steps.en: A small-change model relative to a reference. Cε is in Hz per unit strain (or MHz/με), CT in Hz/K. One shift cannot identify two unknowns.

steps.label: 解耦 / Compensation
steps.zh: 应变测量需要独立温度信息；测温需要已知或隔离的光纤应变。光缆热膨胀与约束会改变有效标定。
steps.en: Strain sensing requires independent temperature information; thermometry requires known or isolated fiber strain. Cable expansion and constraint alter the effective calibration.

routes.limits: 多个相关峰、背景增益与扫描位置标定决定可用范围；通常需要两端接入，不能沿用 OTDR 的脉冲时延公式定位。
routes.limits_en: Multiple correlation peaks, background gain, and position calibration limit the usable range. Usually double-ended; pulse time-of-flight is not the localization rule.

routes.name: 瑞利 OFDR 应变测量
routes.observable: 相对参考状态的局部谱移
routes.obs_en: Local spectral shift relative to a reference
routes.summary: 扫频干涉给出距离，再用局部瑞利谱相关估计轴向光纤应变变化。
routes.sum_en: Swept interferometry establishes distance; local Rayleigh correlation then estimates changes in axial fiber strain.

steps.label: B0 → B1 / BL · 分光 / Split
steps.equation: ν(t)=ν0+κt;  B1 ∝ exp[i2π∫ν(t)dt];  BL is the reference field
steps.zh: 扫频光分为测量与参考支路；辅助不等臂 MZI 提供扫频时钟。κ 为实际光频扫描速率。
steps.en: Split the swept source into measurement and reference branches. An auxiliary unequal-arm MZI supplies the sweep clock; κ is the actual optical-frequency sweep rate.

steps.label: B2 + BL → i · 拍频 / Beat
steps.zh: 回波与参考光相干混频。τrel 是相对参考支路的延迟，需要零点标定，不能默认全部距离从光源开始。
steps.en: Mix the return with the reference. τrel is the delay relative to that arm; calibrate the distance origin rather than assuming it begins at the laser.

steps.label: i → r(z) · 空间变换 / Spatial transform
steps.equation: z-zref = c fb/(2 ng κ);  Δzideal ≈ c/(2 ng Bν)
steps.zh: 按实际光频重采样后作傅里叶变换。Bν 是光频扫描带宽；上述理想分辨率不等于应变标距。
steps.en: Resample on the measured optical-frequency grid before Fourier transformation. Bν is the optical scan bandwidth; ideal reflectometric resolution differs from the strain gauge length.

steps.label: r0 / r1 → q · 指纹相关 / Fingerprint correlation
steps.zh: 在相同窗口内比较参考与当前瑞利指纹；δν 是当前谱相对参考的有符号光频移。通常拉伸导致红移 δν<0，因此 q>0；须按实际相关实现核对符号。
steps.en: Compare reference and current Rayleigh fingerprints in matching windows. δν is the signed current-minus-reference optical-frequency shift. Tension usually gives a red shift δν<0, hence q>0; verify the sign in the actual correlation implementation.

steps.label: q → Δε / ΔT · 解耦 / Compensation
steps.zh: Kε、KT 按此符号约定实测标定；普通硅纤中通常为正。温度和应变同时变化时需第二个独立观测。
steps.en: Calibrate Kε and KT under this sign convention; they are usually positive for ordinary silica fiber. Simultaneous temperature and strain changes require a second independent observation.

routes.limits: 需要保存参考指纹、选择标距并校准温度；局部相关失败时应标记缺测，不能自动填成可靠应变。
routes.limits_en: Retain reference fingerprints, choose a gauge length, and calibrate temperature. Mark failed correlation as missing rather than inventing reliable strain.

routes.name: 频率扫描相干 OTDR
routes.observable: 每个距离窗的瑞利频谱移
routes.obs_en: Rayleigh spectral shift per distance window
routes.summary: 对多个稳定光频分别发射脉冲，用时延定位、频率扫描构建局部指纹，再相关求应变。
routes.sum_en: Launch pulses at multiple stabilized frequencies; use delay for location and the frequency scan for local fingerprint correlation.

steps.label: B0 → Bp / BL · 逐频发射 / Frequency stepping
steps.zh: 光频在各次脉冲之间步进，单次脉冲内保持近似稳定；不同于连续扫频 OFDR。
steps.en: Step frequency between launches and keep it approximately stable within each pulse; this differs from continuously swept OFDR.

steps.label: i(t,νm) → S(z,νm) · 指纹 / Fingerprint
steps.zh: 空间位置由脉冲时延给出；光频轴用于局部指纹相关，不用于 OFDR 距离拍频公式。
steps.en: Pulse delay gives position. The optical-frequency axis is for local fingerprint correlation, not OFDR beat-frequency ranging.

steps.label: r0 / r1 → q · 指纹相关 / Fingerprint correlation
steps.zh: 在相同窗口内比较参考与当前瑞利指纹；δν 是当前谱相对参考的有符号光频移。通常拉伸导致红移 δν<0，因此 q>0；须按实际相关实现核对符号。
steps.en: Compare reference and current Rayleigh fingerprints in matching windows. δν is the signed current-minus-reference optical-frequency shift. Tension usually gives a red shift δν<0, hence q>0; verify the sign in the actual correlation implementation.

steps.label: q → Δε / ΔT · 解耦 / Compensation
steps.zh: Kε、KT 按此符号约定实测标定；普通硅纤中通常为正。温度和应变同时变化时需第二个独立观测。
steps.en: Calibrate Kε and KT under this sign convention; they are usually positive for ordinary silica fiber. Simultaneous temperature and strain changes require a second independent observation.

steps.label: 补偿后应变 / Compensated strain
steps.zh: 同样需要温度补偿与参考状态；整个频率扫描期间应变变化会破坏准静态假设。
steps.en: Temperature compensation and a reference remain necessary; changes during the full frequency scan break the quasi-static assumption.

routes.limits: 频扫相干 OTDR 的谱移法与常见 DAS 相位法不同；扫描时长、频率稳定度和相关窗限制动态测量。
routes.limits_en: Spectral-shift coherent OTDR differs from common phase-based DAS. Scan duration, frequency stability, and correlation windows constrain dynamic measurements.

botdr.title: Kurashima et al. (1993). Brillouin Optical-Fiber Time Domain Reflectometry
botdr.evidence: Publisher and author institution records; spontaneous Brillouin return and coherent detection. No DOI is assigned in the publisher record.

botda.title: Horiguchi & Tateda (1989). Optical-fiber-attenuation investigation using stimulated Brillouin scattering between a pulse and a continuous wave
botda.evidence: Primary research; counter-propagating pulsed pump and CW probe.

dpp.title: Li et al. (2008). Differential pulse-width pair BOTDA for high spatial resolution sensing
dpp.evidence: Primary research; differential pulse-width measurements. DOI verified against publisher metadata.

bofda.title: Garus et al. (1996). Distributed sensing technique based on Brillouin optical-fiber frequency-domain analysis
bofda.evidence: Primary research; complex frequency response and spatial reconstruction.

bocda.title: Hotate & Hasegawa (2000). Measurement of Brillouin Gain Spectrum Distribution along an Optical Fiber Using a Correlation-Based Technique: Proposal, Experiment and Simulation
bocda.evidence: Publisher abstract; frequency-modulated pump/probe and local correlation peak. Publisher lists no DOI.

ofdr.title: Froggatt & Moore (1998). High-spatial-resolution distributed strain measurement in optical fiber with Rayleigh scatter
ofdr.evidence: Primary research; local Rayleigh spectral cross-correlation.

twcotdr.title: Koyamada et al. (2009). Fiber-Optic Distributed Strain and Temperature Sensing With Very High Measurand Resolution Over Long Range Using Coherent OTDR
twcotdr.evidence: Primary research; frequency-controlled coherent OTDR and spectral-shift measurement.
